ci: min1_production.boot nb=5000 CI95 on the de-overlapped win vector, per (pair, side)
enable_bar: CI95-lower > max(0.541, median observed live_breakeven for the (pair, side) from the production executor's quote_snapshot events over >= 3 NY sessions); sparse quote coverage DEFERS the lane
failure: lane stays no-buy permanently absent new evidence
falsifier: issue#4 Phase 5 shifted-offset audit — pre-registered before any outcome data is examined
haircuts: no wall-clock haircut applied anywhere in this lane
scope_v1: own-pair books only; xpair batch join resolved in the strategy-eval run
session: NY 08:00-17:00 America/New_York DST-correct; last buy start 16:44:59 NY
settlement: entry = first tick >= signal_close + 1s (tol 30s, else invalid); exit = last tick <= entry + 900s (exit must lie within 30s of entry+900s, else invalid — fail-closed both ends); mid-to-mid; ties LOSE
trade_stream: chronological first-come-first-served through the per-pair cooldown across offsets and sides (nonoverlap_chrono discipline; spacing 931s = horizon 900s + entry tolerance 30s + 1s, so settlement windows are strictly non-overlapping even at the tolerance edge); max_open/max_trades_day/KILL/lock are runtime risk budgets, NOT simulated — they still bind every live trade
